record.paper_title: Some open problems in Banach space theory
record.original_question: If a Banach space X has the uniform approximation property, must its dual space X* also have the uniform approximation property?

evidence.quote:
(Q.9) Let X have X~ have the UAP ? It is known that the answer is
positive if we restrict ourselves to uniformly convex spaces ~2 a e

artifact.status_search_result: The problem was resolved affirmatively: S. Heinrich showed using ultrapower techniques that if $X$ has the UAP then so does $X^*$ (and conversely). V. Mascioni later gave a more direct proof providing sharp estimates of the UAP constants. So $X$ has UAP iff $X^*$ does.

status_evidence.title: Some approximation properties of Banach spaces and Banach lattices (Johnson–Figiel–Pisier notes)
status_evidence.snippet: It was open for a long time whether the uniform approximation property passes from a space to its dual. This was done by Heinrich using ultra-power techniques. Mascioni gave a direct proof with best estimates.
status_evidence.claim: The UAP is preserved under duality (Heinrich; Mascioni).

status_evidence.title: History, Developments and Open Problems on Approximation Properties
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of approximation properties in Banach spaces, including UAP and its duality behavior.
status_evidence.claim: Standard reference noting the resolution of UAP duality.
